title_zh: 游戏引擎设计：一套接口，如何支撑14款完全不同的游戏
title_en: Game Engine Design: One Interface Pattern Powering 14 Different Games
desc_zh: 最初做第二款游戏的时候，我发现自己在复制粘贴数独的代码。那一刻我意识到必须抽象。这篇文章讲的是我如何设计了一套游戏引擎接口，让每一款新游戏的开发时间从「几周」缩短到「几天」——以及这套设计背后的取舍。
desc_en: When I started building the second game, I found myself copy-pasting Sudoku code. That moment told me I needed abstraction. This article explains how I designed a game engine interface that reduced new game development from weeks to days — and the trade-offs behind the design.
